```{r}
#Imports and Data setup
library(GSE96058)
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(limma)
library(survcomp)

for (OBJ in data(package = "GSE96058")$results[, "Item"])
  assign(sub("GSE96058_", "", OBJ), get(OBJ))

detach(package:GSE96058, unload = TRUE)

full_expression <- cbind(
  geneExpression_sub1,
  geneExpression_sub2,
  geneExpression_sub3,
  geneExpression_sub4,
  geneExpression_sub5,
  geneExpression_repl1
)

df_full <- sampDesc %>%
  filter(isRepl == FALSE,
         er_Status != "NA")

df_erpos_endo <- df_full %>%
  filter(er_Status == 1,
         endocrine_treated == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    lymphNode_binary = case_when(
      lymphNode_Status == "NodeNegative" ~ 0,
      lymphNode_Status == "NodePositive" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    lymphNode_binary = ifelse(is.na(lymphNode_binary), 0, lymphNode_binary),
    pgr_Status       = ifelse(is.na(pgr_Status),  1, pgr_Status),
    her2_Status      = ifelse(is.na(her2_Status),  0, her2_Status),
    tumor_size       = ifelse(is.na(tumor_size),
                              median(tumor_size, na.rm = TRUE), tumor_size),
    ovrallSurvEvent  = as.numeric(ovrallSurvEvent)
  )


expr_endo <- full_expression[,
               colnames(full_expression) %in% df_erpos_endo$title,
               drop = FALSE]

df_erpos_endo <- df_erpos_endo[
  match(colnames(expr_endo), df_erpos_endo$title), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr_endo), df_erpos_endo$title))


```


```{r}
#HYPERPARAMETERS

var_thresh      <- 0.5
pval_thresh     <- 0.05
n_outer_repeats <- 5
n_outer_folds   <- 5
n_inner_folds   <- 5

histopath_vars <- c("nhg", "pgr_Status", "her2_Status",
                    "tumor_size", "ageAtDx", "lymphNode_binary")



#HELPER FUNCTIONS

make_stratified_folds <- function(y, nfolds, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  fold_id <- integer(length(y))
  for (cls in unique(y)) {
    idx <- which(y == cls)
    fold_id[idx] <- sample(rep(seq_len(nfolds), length.out = length(idx)))
  }
  fold_id
}

select_genes_limma <- function(expr_train, event_train,
                               var_thresh, pval_thresh) {
  gv     <- apply(expr_train, 1, var)
  keep_v <- rownames(expr_train)[gv > var_thresh]
  if (length(keep_v) < 2) return(character(0))
  expr_v <- expr_train[keep_v, , drop = FALSE]
  if (length(unique(event_train)) < 2) return(character(0))
  design <- model.matrix(~ event_train)
  fit    <- eBayes(lmFit(expr_v, design))
  tt     <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf,
                     adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "p")
  rownames(tt)[tt$adj.P.Val < pval_thresh]
}

compute_c <- function(lp, surv_time, surv_event) {
  tryCatch(
    concordance.index(
      x          = lp,
      surv.time  = surv_time,
      surv.event = surv_event,
      method     = "noether"
    )$c.index,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

n_outer_total <- n_outer_repeats * n_outer_folds

c_model2 <- numeric(n_outer_total)
c_model3 <- numeric(n_outer_total)

fold_log <- vector("list", n_outer_total)
fit_i    <- 0L

selection_counts_m2 <- integer(0)
coef_sums_m2        <- numeric(0)
selection_counts_m3 <- integer(0)
coef_sums_m3        <- numeric(0)

```


```{r}
#NESTED CV LOOP
#The namings used are model 2 and 3 here, but in the report it's been changed into model 1 and 2.

for (rep_i in seq_len(n_outer_repeats)) {

  cat("=== Repeat", rep_i, "===\n")

  outer_folds <- make_stratified_folds(
    df_erpos_endo$ovrallSurvEvent,
    n_outer_folds,
    seed = 2000 + rep_i
  )

  for (k in seq_len(n_outer_folds)) {

    fit_i  <- fit_i + 1L
    tr_idx <- which(outer_folds != k)
    te_idx <- which(outer_folds == k)

    train_df   <- df_erpos_endo[tr_idx, ]
    test_df    <- df_erpos_endo[te_idx, ]
    train_surv <- Surv(train_df$ovrallSurvDays, train_df$ovrallSurvEvent)
    expr_tr    <- expr_endo[, tr_idx, drop = FALSE]
    expr_te    <- expr_endo[, te_idx, drop = FALSE]

    cat("  Fold", k,
        "| train:", length(tr_idx),
        "| test:",  length(te_idx), "\n")

    # ── Inner loop: gene selection + lambda tuning ──
    inner_folds <- make_stratified_folds(
      train_df$ovrallSurvEvent,
      n_inner_folds,
      seed = 5000 + 100 * rep_i + k
    )

    candidate_genes_inner <- vector("list", n_inner_folds)

    for (ik in seq_len(n_inner_folds)) {
      itr_idx   <- which(inner_folds != ik)
      expr_itr  <- expr_tr[, itr_idx, drop = FALSE]
      event_itr <- train_df$ovrallSurvEvent[itr_idx]
      candidate_genes_inner[[ik]] <- select_genes_limma(
        expr_itr, event_itr, var_thresh, pval_thresh
      )
    }

    union_genes <- unique(unlist(candidate_genes_inner))
    union_genes <- union_genes[nchar(union_genes) > 0]

    cat("    Inner union genes:", length(union_genes), "\n")

    if (length(union_genes) < 2) {
      cat("    Too few genes — skipping M2 and M3\n")
      c_model2[fit_i] <- NA_real_
      c_model3[fit_i] <- NA_real_
      next
    }

    x_tr_inner <- t(expr_tr[union_genes, , drop = FALSE])

    # ── Inner CV: one cv.glmnet gives both lambda.1se and lambda.min ──
    cv_inner <- cv.glmnet(
      x        = x_tr_inner,
      y        = train_surv,
      family   = "cox",
      alpha    = 1,
      foldid   = inner_folds,
      cox.ties = "breslow"
    )

    best_lambda_m2 <- cv_inner$lambda.min   # Model 2
    best_lambda_m3 <- cv_inner$lambda.min   # Model 3

    # ── Fresh limma on full outer train ──
    outer_genes <- select_genes_limma(
      expr_tr, train_df$ovrallSurvEvent,
      var_thresh, pval_thresh
    )

    cat("    Outer DGE genes:", length(outer_genes), "\n")

    if (length(outer_genes) < 2) {
      cat("    Too few outer genes — skipping\n")
      c_model2[fit_i] <- NA_real_
      c_model3[fit_i] <- NA_real_
      next
    }

    x_tr_outer <- t(expr_tr[outer_genes, , drop = FALSE])
    x_te_outer <- t(expr_te[outer_genes, , drop = FALSE])

    # =========================================================
    # MODEL 2 — Gene expression only (LASSO, lambda.min)
    # =========================================================

    final_m2 <- glmnet(
      x        = x_tr_outer,
      y        = train_surv,
      family   = "cox",
      alpha    = 1,
      lambda   = best_lambda_m2,
      cox.ties = "breslow"
    )

    cox2_pred <- as.vector(
      predict(final_m2, newx = x_te_outer,
              s = best_lambda_m2, type = "link")
    )

    c2 <- compute_c(cox2_pred,
                    test_df$ovrallSurvDays,
                    test_df$ovrallSurvEvent)

    cc2      <- coef(final_m2, s = best_lambda_m2)
    cc2_vals <- setNames(as.numeric(cc2), rownames(cc2))
    nz2      <- names(cc2_vals)[cc2_vals != 0]

    cat("    M2 genes:", length(nz2),
        "| lambda:", round(best_lambda_m2, 4),
        "| C:", round(c2, 3), "\n")

    for (g in nz2) {
      prev_n <- if (g %in% names(selection_counts_m2)) selection_counts_m2[[g]] else 0L
      prev_c <- if (g %in% names(coef_sums_m2))        coef_sums_m2[[g]]        else 0
      selection_counts_m2[g] <- prev_n + 1L
      coef_sums_m2[g]        <- prev_c + cc2_vals[g]
    }


    # MODEL 3 — Combined histopath + genes (LASSO, lambda.min)
    # histopath: penalty = 0 (always in)
    # genes: penalty = 1 (LASSO)

    train_hist_mat <- model.matrix(
      ~ nhg + pgr_Status + her2_Status +
        tumor_size + ageAtDx + lymphNode_binary - 1,
      data = train_df
    )
    test_hist_mat <- model.matrix(
      ~ nhg + pgr_Status + her2_Status +
        tumor_size + ageAtDx + lymphNode_binary - 1,
      data = test_df
    )

    common_cols    <- intersect(colnames(train_hist_mat),
                                colnames(test_hist_mat))
    train_hist_mat <- train_hist_mat[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
    test_hist_mat  <- test_hist_mat[,  common_cols, drop = FALSE]
    n_hist_cols    <- ncol(train_hist_mat)

    x_tr_outer_m3 <- cbind(train_hist_mat, x_tr_outer)
    x_te_outer_m3 <- cbind(test_hist_mat,  x_te_outer)
    pen_outer_m3  <- c(rep(0, n_hist_cols),
                       rep(1, length(outer_genes)))

    final_m3 <- glmnet(
      x              = x_tr_outer_m3,
      y              = train_surv,
      family         = "cox",
      alpha          = 1,
      lambda         = best_lambda_m3,
      penalty.factor = pen_outer_m3,
      cox.ties       = "breslow"
    )

    cox3_pred <- as.vector(
      predict(final_m3, newx = x_te_outer_m3,
              s = best_lambda_m3, type = "link")
    )

    c3 <- compute_c(cox3_pred,
                    test_df$ovrallSurvDays,
                    test_df$ovrallSurvEvent)

    cc3       <- coef(final_m3, s = best_lambda_m3)
    cc3_vals  <- setNames(as.numeric(cc3), rownames(cc3))
    nz3_genes <- names(cc3_vals)[cc3_vals != 0 &
                                   names(cc3_vals) %in% outer_genes]

    cat("    M3 genes:", length(nz3_genes),
        "| lambda:", round(best_lambda_m3, 4),
        "| C:", round(c3, 3), "\n")

    for (g in nz3_genes) {
      prev_n <- if (g %in% names(selection_counts_m3)) selection_counts_m3[[g]] else 0L
      prev_c <- if (g %in% names(coef_sums_m3))        coef_sums_m3[[g]]        else 0
      selection_counts_m3[g] <- prev_n + 1L
      coef_sums_m3[g]        <- prev_c + cc3_vals[g]
    }

    # Store
    c_model2[fit_i] <- c2
    c_model3[fit_i] <- c3

    fold_log[[fit_i]] <- list(
      rep        = rep_i,
      fold       = k,
      n_union    = length(union_genes),
      n_outer    = length(outer_genes),
      n_lasso_m2 = length(nz2),
      n_lasso_m3 = length(nz3_genes),
      c_model2   = c2,
      c_model3   = c3
    )
  }
}

```

```{r}
# RESULTS
# Load saved nested CV results
saved <- readRDS("./models/cox_m2_m3_final.rds")

c_model2            <- saved$c_model2
c_model3            <- saved$c_model3
fold_summary        <- saved$fold_summary
selection_counts_m2 <- saved$selection_counts_m2
selection_counts_m3 <- saved$selection_counts_m3
coef_sums_m2        <- saved$coef_sums_m2
coef_sums_m3        <- saved$coef_sums_m3
n_outer_total       <- length(c_model2)

# Results
cat(sprintf("\n\n=== RESULTS (%d outer fits) ===\n\n", n_outer_total))

cat(sprintf(
  "Model 1 — Gene expression only (LASSO, lambda.min):\n  Mean C = %.3f (SD = %.3f, range = %.3f - %.3f)\n\n",
  mean(c_model2, na.rm = TRUE), sd(c_model2, na.rm = TRUE),
  min(c_model2,  na.rm = TRUE), max(c_model2, na.rm = TRUE)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Model 2 — Combined (LASSO, lambda.min):\n  Mean C = %.3f (SD = %.3f, range = %.3f - %.3f)\n\n",
  mean(c_model3, na.rm = TRUE), sd(c_model3, na.rm = TRUE),
  min(c_model3,  na.rm = TRUE), max(c_model3, na.rm = TRUE)
))

fold_sum <- do.call(rbind, lapply(saved$fold_summary, as.data.frame))
cat(sprintf("M1 genes selected: median = %.0f (IQR %.0f-%.0f)\n",
  median(fold_summary$n_lasso_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(fold_summary$n_lasso_m2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(fold_summary$n_lasso_m2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
))
cat(sprintf("M2 genes selected: median = %.0f (IQR %.0f-%.0f)\n\n",
  median(fold_summary$n_lasso_m3, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(fold_summary$n_lasso_m3, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(fold_summary$n_lasso_m3, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
))

# Paired t-test
cat("=== PAIRED T-TEST ===\n\n")
diff  <- c_model3 - c_model2
ttest <- t.test(c_model3, c_model2, paired = TRUE)
cat(sprintf(
  "Model 2 vs Model 1:\n  Mean diff = %+.3f (SD = %.3f), p = %.4f\n\n",
  mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd(diff,   na.rm = TRUE),
  ttest$p.value
))

# Stability selection
stab_thresh <- 0.80

report_stability <- function(sel_counts, coef_sums_vec, label) {
  if (length(sel_counts) == 0) {
    cat(label, "— no genes selected\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  sel_freq <- sort(sel_counts / n_outer_total, decreasing = TRUE)
  stable   <- names(sel_freq)[sel_freq >= stab_thresh]
  cat(sprintf("%s:\n  Genes selected at least once: %d\n", label, length(sel_freq)))
  cat(sprintf("  Stable genes (>= 80%%): %d\n\n", length(stable)))
  if (length(stable) > 0) {
    mean_coef <- coef_sums_vec[stable] / pmax(sel_counts[stable], 1L)
    sig_df <- data.frame(
      gene           = stable,
      selection_freq = round(sel_freq[stable], 3),
      mean_coef      = round(as.numeric(mean_coef), 4),
      row.names      = NULL
    )
    sig_df <- sig_df[order(-sig_df$selection_freq, -abs(sig_df$mean_coef)), ]
    print(sig_df, row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }
  invisible(stable)
}

report_stability(selection_counts_m2, coef_sums_m2, "Model 1 — Gene expression")
report_stability(selection_counts_m3, coef_sums_m3, "Model 2 — Combined")

# Boxplot
comparison_df <- data.frame(
  C_statistic = c(c_model2, c_model3),
  Model = factor(
    c(rep("Model 1\nGenes only\n(LASSO)", n_outer_total),
      rep("Model 2\nCombined\n(LASSO)",   n_outer_total)),
    levels = c("Model 1\nGenes only\n(LASSO)",
               "Model 2\nCombined\n(LASSO)")
  )
)

ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = Model, y = C_statistic, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Model 1\nGenes only\n(LASSO)" = "#F26419",
    "Model 2\nCombined\n(LASSO)"  = "#57A773"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cox Nested CV: Model 1 vs Model 2",
    subtitle = "5 repeats × 5 folds | n=2,512 | lambda.min",
    y        = "C-statistic (Harrell)", x = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
#REFITTING, using top 11 genes from the combined model, which appeared in 70% of all 25 folds. 

genes_m3_top11 <- c("B3GNT7", "VAV3", "PCAT18",
                     "HV592909", "DQ588543", "DQ583069",
                     "GREB1", "KIRREL3", "NR6A1",
                     "HIST1H4J", "DQ577476")


cat(genes_m3_top11)

x_genes <- as.data.frame(
  t(expr_endo[genes_m3_top11, , drop = FALSE])
)

cox3_data <- cbind(
  df_erpos_endo[, c("ovrallSurvDays", "ovrallSurvEvent",
                     "nhg", "pgr_Status", "her2_Status",
                     "tumor_size", "ageAtDx", "lymphNode_binary")],
  x_genes
)

surv_all <- Surv(df_erpos_endo$ovrallSurvDays,
                 df_erpos_endo$ovrallSurvEvent)

cox3_final <- coxph(
  as.formula(paste(
    "surv_all ~ nhg + pgr_Status + her2_Status +",
    "tumor_size + ageAtDx + lymphNode_binary +",
    paste(paste0("`", genes_m3_top11, "`"), collapse = " + ")
  )),
  data = cox3_data,
  x = TRUE
)

cat("C:", round(concordance(cox3_final)$concordance, 3), "\n")

risk3 <- predict(cox3_final, type = "lp")
cuts3 <- quantile(risk3, probs = c(1/3, 2/3))
tier3 <- cut(risk3, breaks = c(-Inf, cuts3, Inf),
             labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))

print(data.frame(
  tier = c("Low", "Medium", "High"),
  n = as.numeric(table(tier3)),
  death_rate = round(tapply(df_erpos_endo$ovrallSurvEvent,
                            tier3, mean) * 100, 1)
))

saveRDS(cox3_final,     "./models/cox3_final.rds")
saveRDS(cuts3,          "./models/cuts3.rds")
saveRDS(genes_m3_top11, "./models/stable_genes_m3.rds")
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(shinyjs)



cox3_final      <- readRDS("./models/cox3_final.rds")
cuts3           <- readRDS("./models/cuts3.rds")
stable_genes_m3 <- readRDS("./models/stable_genes_m3.rds")
df_erpos_endo   <- readRDS("./models/df_erpos_endo.rds")
expr_endo       <- readRDS("./models/expr_endo.rds")

death_rates <- c(Low = 1.2, Medium = 4.9, High = 20.2)
tier_ns     <- c(Low = 838, Medium = 837, High = 837)
c_stat      <- 0.818

get_tier <- function(score, cuts) {
  if (score <= cuts[1]) "Low"
  else if (score <= cuts[2]) "Medium"
  else "High"
}



tier_colour <- function(tier) switch(tier, Low="#1B7A4A", Medium="#C47A00", High="#B02020")
tier_bg     <- function(tier) switch(tier, Low="#EAF5EE", Medium="#FEF6E4", High="#FDECEC")
ordinal <- function(n) {
  s <- ifelse(n %in% c(11,12,13), "th",
       ifelse(n%%10==1,"st", ifelse(n%%10==2,"nd", ifelse(n%%10==3,"rd","th"))))
  paste0(n, s)
}

# Pre-compute KM medians per tier
all_risk3 <- predict(cox3_final, type = "lp")
tier_all  <- cut(all_risk3, breaks = c(-Inf, cuts3, Inf),
                 labels = c("Low","Medium","High"))
km_data <- data.frame(
  time  = df_erpos_endo$ovrallSurvDays,
  event = df_erpos_endo$ovrallSurvEvent,
  tier  = tier_all
)
km_medians <- sapply(c("Low","Medium","High"), function(t) {
  sub <- km_data[km_data$tier == t, ]
  fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = sub)
  med <- summary(fit)$table["median"]
  if (is.na(med)) max(sub$time[sub$event==0], na.rm=TRUE) else med
})

                       color:#AAA; margin:16px 0 8px; padding-bottom:5px; border-bottom:1px solid #F0EDE8; }
    .run-btn { width:100%; padding:11px; background:#1C1C1C; color:white; border:none;
               border-radius:6px; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer;
               margin-top:16px; font-family:inherit; transition:background 0.15s; }
    .run-btn:hover { background:#333; }
    .gene-note { font-size:10px; color:#AAA; margin-top:6px; line-height:1.7;
                 font-family:monospace; word-break:break-all; }
    .content { padding:22px 26px; overflow-y:auto; }
    .empty-state { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center;
                   justify-content:center; height:60vh; text-align:center; }
    .empty-state .icon { font-size:44px; margin-bottom:14px; opacity:0.25; }
    .empty-state h3 { font-size:20px; font-weight:400; color:#BBB; margin-bottom:6px; }
    .empty-state p { font-size:13px; color:#CCC; }
    .card { background:white; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid #E4E0D8;
            overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:18px; }
    .card-header { padding:13px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid #F0EDE8;
                   display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
    .card-header h4 { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; }
    .card-header .meta { font-size:11px; color:#AAA; }
    .card-body { padding:18px; }
    .tier-bar-wrap { display:flex; gap:4px; margin:14px 0 8px; }
    .tier-seg { flex:1; padding:7px 4px; border-radius:5px; text-align:center;
                font-size:11px; font-weight:500; transition:all 0.2s; }
    .tier-seg.active { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
    .driver-row { display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:6px 0; }
    .driver-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:4px 10px;
                  border-radius:14px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; }
    .stat-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
                padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #F5F2EE; font-size:13px; }
    .stat-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
    .stat-label { color:#777; font-weight:300; }
    .stat-val { font-weight:500; }
    .disclaimer { font-size:10px; color:#BBB; text-align:center; padding:10px;
                  border-top:1px solid #E4E0D8; line-height:1.6; }
    .shiny-input-container { margin-bottom:9px; }
    .shiny-input-container label { font-size:11px; font-weight:500; color:#666;
                                   margin-bottom:3px; display:block; }
    .selectize-input { font-size:13px!important; border:1px solid #DDD!important;
                       border-radius:6px!important; box-shadow:none!important;
                       font-family:inherit!important; padding:6px 10px!important; }
    .selectize-input.focus { border-color:#1C1C1C!important; box-shadow:none!important; }
    input[type=number] { width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #DDD;
                         border-radius:6px; font-size:13px; font-family:inherit; background:white; }
    input[type=number]:focus { outline:none; border-color:#1C1C1C; }
    .progress-bar { background-color: #1B7A4A !important; }
    .shiny-file-input-progress { margin-top: 10px !important; }
    .progress { margin-top: 10px !important; height: 20px !important; border-radius: 6px !important; }
  '))),

  div(class="app-header",
    tags$h1(tags$em("Breast Cancer Risk Stratification"))
  ),

  div(class="app-layout",
    div(class="sidebar",
      div(class="section-divider","Clinical"),
      numericInput("age","Age at Diagnosis",value=60,min=20,max=90),
      numericInput("tumor_size","Tumour Size (mm)",value=20,min=1,max=150),
      selectInput("lymph_node","Lymph Node Status",
                  choices=c("Node Negative"=0,"Node Positive"=1)),
      div(class="section-divider","Histopathology"),
      selectInput("nhg","NHG Grade",choices=c("Grade 1"=1,"Grade 2"=2,"Grade 3"=3)),
      selectInput("pgr","PgR Status",choices=c("Positive"=1,"Negative"=0)),
      selectInput("her2","HER2 Status",choices=c("Negative"=0,"Positive"=1)),
      div(class="section-divider","RNA-seq"),
      
      fileInput("rna_csv","Upload Gene Expression CSV",accept=c("text/csv",".csv")),
      actionButton("clear_csv", "Remove CSV", 
                   style="width:100%; margin-top:6px; padding:6px;
                          background:white; color:#888; border:1px solid #DDD;
                          border-radius:6px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer;
                          font-family:inherit;"),
      div(class="gene-note","Required genes:",tags$br(),
            paste(stable_genes_m3,collapse="  ·  ")),
      actionButton("run","Calculate Risk",class="run-btn")
    ),
    
    div(class="content",                          # ← ADD THIS
      conditionalPanel("input.run == 0",
        div(class="empty-state",
          div(class="icon","◎"),
          tags$h3("Enter patient data to begin"),
          tags$p("Upload gene expression CSV and click Calculate Risk.")
        )
      ),
      conditionalPanel("input.run > 0 && !output.has_rna",
        div(class="empty-state",
          div(class="icon","⚠"),
          tags$h3("RNA-seq data required"),
          tags$p("Please upload a gene expression CSV file to calculate risk.",
                 style="color:#C47A00;")
        )
      ),
      conditionalPanel("input.run > 0 && output.has_rna",
        div(class="card",
          div(class="card-header",
            tags$h4("Risk Assessment")
          ),
          div(class="card-body",
            div(style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:center;",
              div(plotOutput("gauge",height="300px")),
              div(uiOutput("risk_label"))
            )
          )
        ),
        div(class="card",
          div(class="card-header",
            tags$h4("Risk Group Comparison"),
            span(class="meta","Where does this patient sit?")
          ),
          div(class="card-body",uiOutput("tier_bar"))
        ),
        div(class="card",
          div(class="card-header",
            tags$h4("Key Risk Drivers"),
            span(class="meta","Top factors for this patient")
          ),
          div(class="card-body",uiOutput("drivers_panel"))
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$clear_csv, {
  reset("rna_csv")
    })
  
  output$has_rna <- reactive({
  !is.null(input$rna_csv) && !is.null(input$rna_csv$datapath)
  })
  outputOptions(output, "has_rna", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
  
  results <- eventReactive(input$run, {

    gene_vals <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(stable_genes_m3)), stable_genes_m3)
    has_rna   <- FALSE

    if (!is.null(input$rna_csv) && !is.null(input$rna_csv$datapath)) {
      tryCatch({
        expr_csv <- read.csv(input$rna_csv$datapath, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
        missing  <- setdiff(stable_genes_m3, colnames(expr_csv))
        if (ncol(expr_csv) != length(stable_genes_m3)) {
          showNotification(paste0("CSV must have exactly ",length(stable_genes_m3),
                                  " gene columns. Found ",ncol(expr_csv),"."),
                           type="error", duration=8)
        } else if (length(missing) > 0) {
          showNotification(paste0("Missing genes: ",paste(missing,collapse=", ")),
                           type="error", duration=8)
        } else {
          gene_vals <- as.numeric(expr_csv[1, stable_genes_m3])
          names(gene_vals) <- stable_genes_m3
          has_rna <- TRUE
        }
      }, error=function(e) showNotification("Could not read CSV.",type="error",duration=8))
    }

    coefs    <- coef(cox3_final)
    means    <- cox3_final$means
    nhg_val  <- as.integer(input$nhg)
    pgr_val  <- as.integer(input$pgr)
    her2_val <- as.integer(input$her2)

    new_vec <- c(
      nhgG2=as.numeric(nhg_val==2), nhgG3=as.numeric(nhg_val==3), nhgNA=0,
      pgr_Status1=as.numeric(pgr_val==1), pgr_StatusNA=0,
      her2_Status1=as.numeric(her2_val==1), her2_StatusNA=0,
      tumor_size=as.numeric(input$tumor_size),
      ageAtDx=as.numeric(input$age),
      lymphNode_binary=as.numeric(input$lymph_node)
    )
    gene_input <- if (has_rna) gene_vals[stable_genes_m3] else means[stable_genes_m3]
    new_vec    <- c(new_vec, gene_input)

    risk <- tryCatch(
      sum(coefs * (new_vec[names(coefs)] - means[names(coefs)]), na.rm=TRUE),
      error=function(e) NA_real_
    )

    tier     <- if (!is.na(risk)) get_tier(risk, cuts3) else NA_character_
    all_risk <- predict(cox3_final, type="lp")
    pct      <- if (!is.na(risk)) round(mean(all_risk <= risk)*100) else NA

    contrib <- coefs * (new_vec[names(coefs)] - means[names(coefs)])
    contrib  <- contrib[!is.na(contrib)]

    # Personalised survival probabilities
# Personalised survival probabilities
    surv_1yr <- surv_3yr <- surv_5yr <- NA
    tryCatch({
      nhg_str <- switch(as.character(as.integer(input$nhg)),
                        "1" = "G1", "2" = "G2", "3" = "G3", "G1")

      nd <- data.frame(
        nhg              = nhg_str,
        pgr_Status       = as.character(as.integer(input$pgr)),
        her2_Status      = as.character(as.integer(input$her2)),
        tumor_size       = as.numeric(input$tumor_size),
        ageAtDx          = as.numeric(input$age),
        lymphNode_binary = as.numeric(input$lymph_node),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      gene_input <- if (has_rna) gene_vals[stable_genes_m3] else means[stable_genes_m3]
      for (g in stable_genes_m3) nd[[g]] <- gene_input[g]

      fit_surv  <- survfit(cox3_final, newdata = nd)
      s_summary <- summary(fit_surv, times = c(365, 1095, 1826))
      sp        <- s_summary$surv
      if (length(sp) >= 1) surv_1yr <- round(sp[1]*100, 1)
      if (length(sp) >= 2) surv_3yr <- round(sp[2]*100, 1)
      if (length(sp) >= 3) surv_5yr <- round(sp[3]*100, 1)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    list(risk=risk, tier=tier, pct=pct,
         has_rna=has_rna, gene_vals=gene_vals, contrib=contrib,
         surv_1yr=surv_1yr, surv_3yr=surv_3yr, surv_5yr=surv_5yr)
  })

  output$gauge <- renderPlot({
    res <- results()
    if (is.na(res$tier)) return(NULL)
    pct         <- res$pct
    gauge_angle <- pi - (pct/100)*pi
    theta_full  <- seq(pi, 0, length.out=300)
    par(mar=c(1.5,1,1,1), bg="white")
    plot(0,0,type="n",xlim=c(-1.4,1.4),ylim=c(-0.4,1.3),asp=1,axes=FALSE,xlab="",ylab="")
    lines(cos(theta_full),sin(theta_full),lwd=20,col="#EEEBE6")
    for (z in list(list(from=pi,to=pi*2/3,col="#1B7A4A"),
                   list(from=pi*2/3,to=pi*1/3,col="#C47A00"),
                   list(from=pi*1/3,to=0,col="#B02020"))) {
      th <- seq(z$from,z$to,length.out=80)
      lines(cos(th),sin(th),lwd=20,col=z$col)
    }
    nx <- cos(gauge_angle)*0.70; ny <- sin(gauge_angle)*0.70
    segments(0,0,nx,ny,lwd=3,col="#1C1C1C",lend=1)
    points(0,0,pch=21,bg="#1C1C1C",col="white",cex=2.5,lwd=2)
    text(-1.22,0.20,"LOW",cex=0.70,col="#1B7A4A",font=2)
    text(0,1.18,"MEDIUM",cex=0.70,col="#C47A00",font=2)
    text(1.22,0.20,"HIGH",cex=0.70,col="#B02020",font=2)
    text(0,-0.26,paste0(ordinal(pct)," percentile"),cex=0.80,col="#777")
  }, bg="white")

  output$risk_label <- renderUI({
    res    <- results()
    if (is.na(res$tier)) return(NULL)
    col    <- tier_colour(res$tier)
    bg_col <- tier_bg(res$tier)
    dr     <- death_rates[res$tier]
    med    <- km_medians[res$tier]

    interp <- switch(res$tier,
      Low    = "Low risk patients have a favourable prognosis. Standard endocrine therapy follow-up is appropriate.",
      Medium = "Intermediate risk. Enhanced monitoring or clinical discussion may be warranted.",
      High   = "High risk of mortality. Intensified treatment strategy or multidisciplinary review is recommended."
    )
    
  
    surv_1yr <- res$surv_1yr
    surv_3yr <- res$surv_3yr
    surv_5yr <- res$surv_5yr

    surv_row <- function(label, val) {
      div(style=paste0("display:flex;justify-content:space-between;",
                       "padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F2EE;font-size:13px;"),
        span(style="color:#777;", label),
        span(style=paste0("font-weight:600;color:",col),
             if (is.na(val)) "—" else paste0(val,"%"))
      )
    }

    div(style="padding:8px 0;",
      div(style=paste0("font-size:32px;font-weight:700;color:",col,
                       ";letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:8px;"),
          toupper(res$tier)," RISK"),
      div(style=paste0("display:inline-block;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:16px;",
                       "background:",bg_col,";color:",col,
                       ";font-size:13px;font-weight:500;",
                       "border:1px solid ",col,"33;margin-bottom:14px;"),
          paste0(dr,"% group death rate")),
      div(style="margin-bottom:14px;",
        div(style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;
                   text-transform:uppercase;color:#AAA;margin-bottom:4px;",
            "Personalised Survival Estimates"),
        surv_row("1-year survival", surv_1yr),
        surv_row("3-year survival", surv_3yr),
        surv_row("5-year survival", surv_5yr)
      ),
      div(style="font-size:13px;color:#444;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:8px;", interp)
    )
  })

  output$tier_bar <- renderUI({
    res <- results()
    if (is.na(res$tier)) return(NULL)
    pt   <- res$tier
    cols <- c(Low="#1B7A4A",Medium="#C47A00",High="#B02020")
    bgs  <- c(Low="#EAF5EE",Medium="#FEF6E4",High="#FDECEC")
    segs <- lapply(c("Low","Medium","High"), function(t) {
      act <- t == pt
      div(class=paste("tier-seg",if(act)"active" else ""),
          style=paste0("background:",if(act)bgs[t] else "#F5F2EE",";",
                       "border:",if(act)paste0("2px solid ",cols[t]) else "1px solid #E4E0D8",";",
                       "color:",if(act)cols[t] else "#AAA",";"),
        div(style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;",toupper(t)),
        div(style=paste0("font-size:16px;font-weight:700;",
                         if(act)paste0("color:",cols[t]) else ""),
          paste0(death_rates[t], "% death risk"))
      )
    })
    div(
      div(style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-bottom:8px;",
          HTML(paste0("This patient is in the <strong>", pt, "</strong> risk group."))),
      div(class="tier-bar-wrap", segs)
    )
  })

  output$drivers_panel <- renderUI({
    res <- results()
    if (is.na(res$tier)) return(NULL)
    col    <- tier_colour(res$tier)
    contrib <- res$contrib
    label_map <- c(
      nhgG2="NHG Grade 2", nhgG3="NHG Grade 3",
      pgr_Status1="PgR Positive", her2_Status1="HER2 Positive",
      tumor_size="Tumour Size", ageAtDx="Age at Diagnosis",
      lymphNode_binary="Lymph Node Positive",
      B3GNT7="B3GNT7", VAV3="VAV3", PCAT18="PCAT18",
      HV592909="HV592909", DQ588543="DQ588543", DQ583069="DQ583069",
      GREB1="GREB1", KIRREL3="KIRREL3", NR6A1="NR6A1",
      HIST1H4J="HIST1H4J", DQ577476="DQ577476"
    )
    
    df_c <- data.frame(variable = names(contrib), 
                       contribution = as.numeric(contrib),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(label = ifelse(variable %in% names(label_map), 
                            label_map[variable], variable)) %>%
      filter(!variable %in% c("nhgNA", "pgr_StatusNA", "her2_StatusNA"))
    
    risk_d <- df_c %>% arrange(desc(contribution)) %>% head(3)
    prot_d <- df_c %>% arrange(contribution)        %>% head(3)

    make_tags <- function(drivers, col, bg, arrow) {
      if (nrow(drivers)==0) return(div(style="color:#AAA;font-size:12px;","None"))
      div(class="driver-row",
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(drivers)), function(i)
          div(class="driver-tag",
              style=paste0("background:",bg,";color:",col,";border:1px solid ",col,"33;"),
            span(arrow), span(drivers$label[i]))))
    }
    div(
          div(style="margin-bottom:14px;",
            div(style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#B02020;","INCREASING RISK"),
            div(style="margin-top:6px;",make_tags(risk_d,"#B02020","#FDECEC","↑"))
          ),
          div(
            div(style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#1B7A4A;","DECREASING RISK"),
            div(style="margin-top:6px;",make_tags(prot_d,"#1B7A4A","#EAF5EE","↓"))
        )
    )
  })
}
shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)
```
